target_customer: Product managers, designers and engineers on React teams who want to edit code visually
problem: Designers and PMs cannot change production React code directly. Tempo offers a design tool style visual editor that works on real code, with AI agents, optimized for Vite and Tailwind.
product_category: Visual editor and AI app builder for React

founders.name: Kevin Michael
founders.background_notes: YC page says 5 years as founding engineer and head of product at Perpetua ($150M exit), product fellow at Social Capital, and engineer on the Visual Studio team at Microsoft.

founders.name: Peter Gokhshteyn
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was employee 3 at Perpetua and led engineering to product market fit.

technical_complexity.rationale: A visual editor that round trips edits into real React and Tailwind code is hard, and adding AI agents adds more complexity for an 8 person team.

defensibility.rationale: Large AI builders and design tools can add React editing, and the value rests on execution and code quality.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: One directory later names v0, Bolt.new and Lovable as competitors; no acquisition of Tempo found.

market_need_then: Not established with a dated source. The collaboration gap between design and code was known, and AI code tools drew heavy interest from 2023, but no dated demand evidence was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses tempo.new, a .new domain, not an exact .com; the legal company name is Tempo Labs.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: The IDE for the whole team

branding.community_and_virality: Directory profiles report a Product Hunt number one product of the day, undated and unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Very common word shared with many unrelated companies, including acquired and defunct Tempo startups, so search confusion is high. The Product Hunt rank is only a directory claim.

outcome_analysis: Tempo is led by two founders who built Perpetua through a 150 million exit and raised a 5 million seed in October 2025 from YC, Golden Ventures, Webflow Ventures, iNovia and others, with General Catalyst reported by a profile. It is active in a crowded AI builder field with no later round yet, so the outcome is open.
notes: Seed confirmed by a press release and Private Capital Journal; CB Insights lists 7.5M total, conflicting and unverified. Investor list is from search summaries of the release and profiles; General Catalyst appears in only some. tempo.new returned only a title. No dated 2023 competitor source found, only 2025 directory listings, so the list is empty. Education not found. An unrelated Tempo e-commerce app shutdown story is a different company.
